I create a new conversation for the current user.
The response is streamed using Server-Side events (SSE) according to the spec here https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events
This endpoint will only ever return a 200 status code.  The actual status of the response will be in the sse event names.
Valued event names are defined in `StandardSseEventNames.cs` as well as  - currently unauthorized, not-found, forbidden, bad-request, internal-server-error, end-of-stream, conversation-id, response-updated
Design Note: The convention of byGptSystem goes a little against REST (because the GET endpoints are not also keyed by this, the alternate would to be to have different models for Public (which is keyed by endpoint name) and User (which are keyed by GptSystemId)
But that feels like a lot of extra work and maintenance to be a little more academically correct -so we are being pragmatic here.
If the question is either of the magic strings --ReturnErrorAtStart-- --ReturnErrorAfterFirstResponsePacket-- then the server will return an error for testing/dev purposes.

This endpoint will only ever return a 200 status code.  The actual status of the response will be in the sse event names.

But that feels like a lot of extra work and maintenance to be a little more academically correct -so we are being pragmatic here.
